bug_semantics: Malformed LAN-local mDNS packets reach DNSIncoming name decoding. The exception-dedup path keyed a process-lifetime dictionary by attacker-varying exception text and stored the full sys.exc_info() triple; each retained traceback kept frame locals including the raw packet buffer, so unique malformed packets caused unbounded memory growth and eventual denial of service.
flaw_origin: Commit 061a2aa3c6e8a7c954a313c8a7d396f26f544c2b first added DNSIncoming._seen_exceptions, caught parser exceptions, keyed the unbounded class dictionary by the exception string, and stored sys.exc_info(). Its immediate parent 94570b730aaab606db820b9c4d48b1c313fdaa98 has no _seen_exceptions, sys.exc_info, or exception-dedup handler in zeroconf.py. Later commits refactored the state into QuietLogger and added source/offset/link detail, but did not originate the retention mechanism.
ai_marker: none: the BIC is a single-parent commit authored and committed by Stephen Rauch on 2016-07-08, with no co-author trailer, AI attribution, or Git note; it predates modern generative coding assistants.
evidence: The advisory identifies GHSA-phvx-9mgw-67r5 / CVE-2026-47183, affected versions <0.149.6, patched version 0.149.6, and the UDP/5353 traceback-retention mechanism.

git show of 061a2aa3c6e8a7c954a313c8a7d396f26f544c2b adds _seen_exceptions = {}, catches IndexError/struct.error/IncomingDecodeError, assigns exc_info = sys.exc_info(), and stores it under str(exc_info[1]).
git grep against parent 94570b730aaab606db820b9c4d48b1c313fdaa98 finds none of _seen_exceptions, sys.exc_info, or log_exception_warning; the parent constructs DNSIncoming without this retention path.
Tag ancestry shows 0.17.6 resolves to the BIC parent and does not contain the BIC, while 0.17.7 contains it and is the first containing release tag.
git show of 95561e28b24922358f1991e38e3a86d70d72dcec replaces stored exc_info values with bounded dict[str, None] pools capped at 512 and routes both parser and QuietLogger paths through _mark_seen.
0.149.5 resolves to fix parent 65b22cb8de06dcb40a8ee21b04ce84e9aa0dac91 and lacks the fix; tag 0.149.6 resolves to 9683fe6ade7ee080e161fb30c7325024d1d3e02f and contains the direct fix.
reasoning: The vulnerability is real and the complete source-to-sink lifecycle closes locally. The smallest public commit that created the retained-traceback dedup mechanism is 061a2aa3c6e8a7c954a313c8a7d396f26f544c2b, not later moves, logging-level changes, or additions of self.source to error strings. The immediate parent lacks the mechanism. The BIC's 2016 first-party human metadata and absence of any AI signal make AI authorship inapplicable, so the correct verdict is NOT_AI. Commit 95561e28b24922358f1991e38e3a86d70d72dcec directly bounds both pools and stops retaining exc_info, and release topology confirms 0.149.6 as the first fixed release.
